title: Guest-local response-v2 credential delivery
description: Structural contract only. Requires a separately cold-assigned delivery authority, retained protected originals, real generation and TEE verification, and original guest BOOTTIME admission. Does not grant readiness or provision secrets.

ns.description: Canonical positive u64 decimal BOOTTIME nanoseconds; arithmetic and the <=600-second original window are enforced by the owner.

path.description: Absolute normal UTF-8 path. Runtime rejects symlinks and writable untrusted ancestors and retains the original descriptor and identity.

authority.description: Optional guestDeliveryAuthority on the protected cold custody configuration. keyId is SHA256 of exact decoded32 public bytes, distinct from the generation root and all runtime role keys. Absent/null preserves the host profile. This authority is independently provisioned, never inherited from the store signer.

roleKey.description: Exact signed-topology role descriptor paths and public hash. Both originals are exactly32 bytes; actual seed-derived public key and key ID must match. No duplicate role names.

credentials.description: Exactly the selected service's signed key inventory, no other role seeds. Manifest originals are 1..4194304 bytes, trust root exactly32. All credential originals are regular single-link0400 files owned by the exact signed service UID/GID.

envelope.description: Original canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON, no LF, <=65536 bytes. Signature is Ed25519 over UTF-8 serverware.responseV2.guestCredentialDelivery.signature/v1 followed by NUL then existing custody canonical_json_bytes(payload). Canonical unpadded base64url64; no embedded public key. Root-owned regular single-link0400 or0444 envelope, exact CLI hash, retained descriptor.
